Broker tests assert exact clocks/full-row digest/detachment, live-inventory refusal and malformed/wrong-target/child/fill/failure/material/clock negatives. These are static coverage observations, not reviewer-executed results.

Unrun owner test reuses the retained core cleanup fixture, obtains actual original entry/close/cleanup through existing source owner functions, supplies a terminal target GET and checks no canonical projection/TradeResult mutation or second cancel.
